title: A new rule merged into an existing one
shows: The Builder writes a rule; code finds a near-duplicate (similarity >= 0.75) of the same type and kind and merges it into rule_6 ("merged a new rule into rule_6") instead of adding a second rule; its task is kept as extra evidence.
why_interesting: Keeps the manual small. Merging never widens a rule's scope (a rule for one kind of task is never merged into another kind).
